name: Swarm of Rats
printing: Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, released in 2025. Current publisher digital text.
operationalEvidence: The swarm climbs at 30 ft. and has 30-ft. Darkvision. Bites has a 5-ft. reach and a smaller piercing damage roll while Bloodied.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata does not list an update for this creature.
habitatEvidence: The publisher stat block lists Forest, Swamp, Underdark, Urban.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on the verified reused portrait.

name: Swarm of Ravens
printing: Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, released in 2025. Current publisher digital text.
operationalEvidence: Cacophony targets one creature in the swarm’s space. The failed save applies Deafened and Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls through the start of the swarm’s next turn.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata does not list an update for this creature.
habitatEvidence: The publisher stat block lists Hill, Swamp, Urban.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on the verified reused portrait.

name: Swarm of Venomous Snakes
printing: Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, released in 2025. Current publisher digital text.
operationalEvidence: Both Bites damage profiles add 10 (3d6) poison damage on a hit. The modern attack calls for no separate poison save.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata does not list an update for this creature.
habitatEvidence: The publisher stat block lists Coastal, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Swamp.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on the verified swarm portrait attributed to the earlier Swarm of Poisonous Snakes entry.
